Project prospectus / October 2026

Evade Research.
The weekly perspective.

A proposed paid macro newsletter for young and newer investors, including finance students. Focused on US and European equity markets.

Read the historical pilot ↗

Understand the forces behind the headline. Build a foundation for thinking about markets, one useful concept at a time.

The reader

Curious, early in their investing journey and comfortable asking why. The newsletter aims to bridge economic theory and the daily market conversation without assuming specialist vocabulary.

The intended weekly format

  • A focused macro briefing with an explicit cutoff.
  • Possible implications for broad US and European indices.
  • Alternative scenarios and questions to watch.
  • One learning concept and links to original sources.

The proposed offer

Evade Weekly at a test price of €8/month. This is a business-model assumption, not a live subscription offer. No checkout, billing or recurring payments are enabled.

The historical pilot

One cut, two economies, no automatic equity signal. Information cutoff: 14 June 2024. The sample examines the ECB’s June cut and the Fed’s June hold as an educational example. It is not current market analysis.

The method

Start with a question. Verify dates and facts against primary sources. Separate facts from interpretation, explain the mechanism, show uncertainty and review the work before publication.

The status

A course assignment and portfolio project relevant to sales & trading career development. AI tools assisted with research, drafting, financial modelling and website implementation. The prototype has no live subscriber database, email integration or payment system.

Educational research for general information. No personal investment advice, trade recommendations or guarantee of returns. Investing involves risk, including loss of capital. Historical examples do not describe current markets.
